# Milestones and next work

## Completed: basic context exchange and native dispatch

- Basic CHANG1/CHANJOB exchange, MPAC/MODE, LOC/BANKSET debris, PUSHLOC/PRIORITY,
  FIXLOC and OVFIND behavior match controlled original assembly executions.
- Historical two-word addresses map explicitly to native C continuations.
- Eight sequential two-job executions cover admission, yielding, completion,
  priority relations and stale core/VAC data; 53 cases / 109 checkpoints match.
- Actual native callbacks run on host and PAL C64 VICE, with fresh evidence.
- No generic ready queue or interpreter dispatch was introduced.

Acceptance for this milestone is met: two native basic jobs with different
priorities are executed, yielded and completed, with resource/state exchanges
and observed continuation order matching controlled original executions.
See DISPATCH.md for the precise continuation and startup adaptations.

## Completed: platform exclusion and interrupt request delivery

reset contract. PERFORMANCE.md reports observed operation and latency samples;
callback/source/mask bounds are still application requirements, not flight proof.

## Next guidance group: updated velocity

VSU VBIAS, implicit quotient-fed VXSC, VSL2, VAD V, implicit vector VAD and
STOVL 24D/R. Reusable arithmetic, Executive and phase services proceed as

altitude and acceleration arithmetic, CDU rotation, measured acceleration,
force clamps, throttle, horizontal-speed display and live scheduling/recovery.

## Run Luminary and Comanche IMU mode switching as native routines

Every word of IMU_MODE_SWITCHING_ROUTINES in both programs (660 Luminary099 words, 656 Comanche055 words, in fixed-fixed and banks 07, 04/07 and 37/26) is compiled native C on the control-transfer ABI. The 72 routines per mission cover ZEROICDU, IMUZERO, coarse and fine align, PIPUSE/PIPFREE, gyro torquing (IMUPULSE, STRTGYRO, 8192AUG), the mode ends, the optics and IMU stalls, GOMANUR, R02BOTH and P06/P05, and every point where they resume after an outside call. Channels 11-14 and the interrupt-enable state are part of the comparison. All 63,488 cases equal the original programs in all 2,048 erasable words, the interrupt state and the channels. That is 55,296 runs from each routine to the point where control leaves the file, and 8,192 round trips from every genuine `TC BANKCALL`/`IBNKCALL` of these routines through the native INTER-BANK routines. The yaAGC oracle drops only the engine's gyro, CDU drive and optics device block. The 127,452 strict and sanitizer checks pass, and nine C64 diagnostics pass 1,504 frozen cases in VICE. Round trips stop at SWRETURN/ISWRETRN entered with Q 3 until the INTER-BANK context fix merges. A complete certificate for both files is drafted for the auditor. See `docs/IMU-MODE-SWITCHING.md`.

That is 8,497 strict and sanitizer checks, with all 32 entries and all 21 exits reached, and every 15th case matches in VICE. STATEUP (bank 13, interpretive) remains. Lane A2 (restart, telemetry and support). See `docs/LM-V37.md`.

## Translate Luminary FRESH_START_AND_RESTART (bank 13: STATEUP and THISVINT) as interpretive transfer-ABI routines

Every order pair of Luminary099 FRESH_START_AND_RESTART in bank 13 (STATEUP, which extrapolates the CSM and LM state vectors for P00, and THISVINT) runs as an interpretive routine of the control-transfer ABI, keyed by LOC at NEWOPS, through the existing compiled interpreter paths. 4,096 cases from all 11 pairs equal the original Luminary099 program in the interrupt-enable state, SUPERBNK and all 2,048 erasable words. That is 11,727 strict and sanitizer checks, with every pair and all seven exits reached, and every 16th case matches in VICE. With `lm-fresh-start` and `lm-v37` this covers every instruction of the file but the patch-only STARTSIM. Lane A2 (restart, telemetry and support). See `docs/LM-STATEUP.md`.

## Translate Luminary TRIM_GIMBAL_CONTROL_SYSTEM as transfer-ABI routines

All of Luminary099 TRIM_GIMBAL_CONTROL_SYSTEM (banks 21 and 16, 388 words) runs as four native routines of the control-transfer ABI, with channel 12 in `lm_flight_io`. The routines are GTS (the trim gimbal control law, with GTSQRT and ROOTCYCL compiled inline), ACDT+C12, TIMEGMBL and its IBNKCALL return. 16,211 of 16,384 cases equal the original program in the outcome, channel 12 and all 2,048 erasable words (strict and ASAN/UBSAN). These include 138 zero-root DOSHIFT passes, where the INDEX SHFTFLAG'd CA BIT15 reads 04735 + ACENTRAL/2 (erasable memory, or a generated bank 21 and fixed-fixed table). The remaining 173 GTS cases index CA BIT15 into another order, which needs an offset acceleration above 8.6 deg/s^2; GTS refuses them with the image unchanged. DV is `ai_dv`, and the oracle runs every DV through yaAGC's SimulateDV hardware model. Each case runs from its entry to CLOSEOUT, the caller's return, or ACDT+C12 reached through the native IBNKCALL. Every routine and reachable branch is taken, every assembled word maps to its native owner after a fresh yaYUL assembly, and 256 C64 rows chosen to take every entry, outcome and branch the host cases take pass in VICE. See `docs/LM-TRIM-GIMBAL.md`.

## Run the Luminary IMU performance tests (P07) as native routines

Every word of Luminary099 IMU_PERFORMANCE_TEST_2 and IMU_PERFORMANCE_TESTS_4 (585 words, bank 37) is compiled native C on the control-transfer ABI: 40 basic and 14 interpretive routines covering P07's gyro drift, PIPA and torque tests, the erasable return lists, ERTHRVSE and EARTHR, ESTIMS and the ALFLT/NORMLOP filter loop with its matrix orders. The 55,414 strict, part-dispatch and sanitizer checks pass, and five C64 diagnostics pass 685 frozen cases in VICE; 63 sampled cases are host-only because they reach the ALFLT loop, which does not fit in C64 RAM, or need code from more than one part.
